We are proud of our diverse and dedicated team of staff, volunteers and interns, who represent different backgrounds, nationalities, and ages. When you join the EAC, you become part of a dynamic team where you can make meaningful contributions, develop new or further improve your existing skills. Discover below our volunteer and internship opportunities in The Hague. 
 Volunteering 
Volunteers are integral to our mission, contributing to various projects that align with their skills and interests. While we welcome individuals from all professional and academic backgrounds, experience in archival studies, library sciences, marketing, or social media is particularly valued. We provide role-specific training to ensure every volunteer is well-prepared. 
We look for enthusiastic, curious, and computer-literate individuals interested in social history. Volunteering takes place at our office in The Hague on an agreed day of the week. We ask for a commitment of at least 6 hours per week for a minimum of 6 months. Our opening hours are from 10:00 to 16:00, Monday through Thursday. English is the working language. All applicants must hold a valid EU work permit. 
There are two main groups of volunteers: archival and content creator. Occasionally, we offer project-specific volunteering opportunities that may require particular skills. All available volunteer openings are listed on this page. We also accept open applications for archival and content creator volunteers year-round. 
Are you looking for a volunteer opportunity? Submit your volunteer application . 
Due to the current high volume of applications, you may be invited to join our waiting list.

Your role at RiverD 
We are looking for an experienced Optomechanical Engineer to join our Engineering team. In this role, you will be the key link between optical design and production, ensuring that our spectrometer systems are backed by robust procedures, well-designed tooling, and clear technical documentation, keeping production aligned with design intent.

What we're looking for - MSc in Optical Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline - 5+ years of experience in an optomechanical or optical instrumentation engineering role - Experience with CAD (e.g. Solid Edge) and tooling design for optical assembly - Proficiency in Zemax OpticStudio - Proven experience with optomechanical design for production: tolerancing, mounts, fixtures, and assembly procedures - Methodical and structured in approach: plans work carefully, executes, verifies, and documents - Experience in optical spectroscopy is a plus 
Other requirements - Proficient in English (spoken and written) - You must have the legal right to work in the EU

We offer a competitive starting salary, dependent on experience and qualifications, and participation in the RiverD pension plan.

 Skin Applications Scientist 
 Job opening 
RiverD International BV develops and produces unique high-quality optical instruments for in vivo analysis of the human skin using Raman spectroscopy. The instruments are sold worldwide to personal care and pharmaceutical industries and to universities and university hospitals. RiverD also develops Raman spectroscopic instruments for other medical and life sciences applications. 
We are looking for an Applications Scientist to support the work on in vivo skin analysis and skin permeation of topical products, and to engage with customers to learn and understand what customers need. You will join a team of experts in the field of Raman spectroscopic analysis of the skin. The job location is Rotterdam. 
What you will be doing: - Plan and conduct feasibility studies using the gen2-SCA Skin Composition Analyzer - Support the gen2-SCA Operator Training, which is given four times per year - Engage with customers at exhibitions, customer visits, and other opportunities - Interact with marketing to convert customer needs into actions - Validate new methods for skin analysis - Act as Chemistry Safety Officer, organizing the safe handling of chemicals at RiverD. 
What we are looking for: - MSc in life sciences or relevant biomedical or biochemical discipline - Team player, easy communication, customer orientation - Quality-conscious with a proactive and hands-on mentality - Comfortable working with a quality management system (e.g. ISO 13485, ISO 9001) 
Other requirements: - Proficient in English (spoken and written) - You must have the legal right to work in the EU 
Salary and benefits: 
We offer a competitive starting salary, depending on experience and qualifications, plus participation in the RiverD pension plan.
